subject: Re: ARA optimization status: synthetic baselines, generalization risk
body:
Umar, Daniela,

Decisions for the July 20 readout:

1. We lead with the real-slice number, 12%, and show 31% synthetic as context only. Umar's instinct is right — a number we can't reproduce on partner data is a liability.
2. Chiara extends the synthetic generator with heavy-tailed count distributions in Q3, so the gap closes or we learn why it doesn't.
3. Partner-facing recommender is deferred out of this window. We have a method, not yet a product, and saying so now costs less than saying it in a launch review.

Nikhil, please attach the RMSRE-tau tables for both settings to the deck appendix.

Dmitri
